conditional_resource_certificates.scope: Conditional ordered fee/return certificates with available access, parts, given outcome words and fixed prices. Includes grants0..20 and extends through30 to test the claimed25 nonwriter threshold. Not a replacement controller, a new physical model, an empirical receipt prediction or a full-mixture selection probability.
conditional_resource_certificates.source_boundary: Probe and copy banks stay separate. Source is consumed only at the corresponding work/return event; unused source is retained. A wrapper around the imported copier must separately prove external reservation/debit, which this fee certificate does not construct.
